outlook.statement: ICRA expects domestic steel demand growth to improve to approximately 9-10% in FY2026-27, supported by increased Government capital expenditure in roads, railways and infrastructure-related sectors.

The outlook for the Indian steel industry remains positive, supported by India's economic growth, infrastructure development, urbanisation, manufacturing expansion and increasing demand from construction, automotive, engineering, renewable energy and other steel-intensive industries.
